subject: Zoda Spawn
text: Zoda Spawn are little balls with tentacles from Zoda's ship in the first game.

evidence.quote: ZODA SPAWN: These are just little balls with tentacles. You'll remember...them from Zoda's ship in the first game.

subject: Caterpillar
text: Caterpillars look like floating caterpillars with glasses and occasionally spray three shots.

evidence.quote: CATERPILLAR: These guys look like floating caterpillars to me with...glasses. Like the kind from Alice in Wonderland. They will spray three...shots occasionally, but otherwise are easy to defeat.

subject: Blue Scorpions
text: Blue Scorpions can shoot two shots in one direction.

evidence.quote: BLUE SCORPIONS: This version of the scorpion can shoot two shots in one...direction.

subject: Blue Asp
text: Blue Asp is a big asp that takes several hits to defeat.

evidence.quote: BLUE ASP: Big asp that takes several hits to defeat.

subject: Cactus Guys
text: Cactus Guys should be defeated diagonally because they explode in a cross direction when defeated.

evidence.quote: CACTUS GUYS: These guys should be defeated diagonally because when you...defeat them they explode in a cross direction.

subject: Treasure Chest
text: Unfriendly treasure chests jump around and turn into coins when attacked.

evidence.quote: TREASURE CHEST: Not all treasure chests are friendly. You will see...some that jump around and turn into coins when they are attacked....These are moderately difficult.

subject: Red Caterpillar
text: Red Caterpillars take more hits and do more damage than other caterpillars.

evidence.quote: RED CATERPILLAR: Just like the other caterpillars only they take more...hits adn do more damage.

subject: Blue Bats
text: Blue Bats are found in Castle Dracula and take two hits to defeat.

evidence.quote: BLUE BATS: These are found in castle dracula and take two hits to...defeat.

subject: Frankenstein
text: Frankenstein creatures move slowly, but after a few hits their torso drops off into a faster pair of legs.

evidence.quote: FRANKENSTEIN: These are slow moving creatures but after a few hits...their torso drops off and they are a much faster pair of legs.

subject: Ghosts
text: Ghosts appear in groups, and the one that is a different color than the rest is the only one you can successfully hit.

evidence.quote: GHOSTS: These generally appear in groups. Look for the one that is a...different color than the rest as this will be the only one you can...successfully hit.

subject: Tombstone Ghost
text: Tombstone Ghosts can only be hit from behind in their tombstone and occasionally fire a shot at you.

evidence.quote: TOMBSTONE GHOST: These guys can only be hit from behind in their...tombstone. Occasionally they fire a shot at you.

subject: Magician
text: Magicians walk around leaving explosives that explode after a few moments.

evidence.quote: MAGICIAN: These guys walk around leaving explosives that explode after...a few moments. Avoid these and shoot at him when you get an opportunity.

subject: Priests
text: Priests leave bubbles that shoot back at you when hit, and priests usually hide behind them.

evidence.quote: PRIESTS: These guys leave bubbles like magicians except that they don't...explode. Instead when you accidentally (or intentionally) hit these...they shoot back at you. Priests will usually hide behind these as well.

subject: Rock Guys
text: Rock Guys take a couple hits and will explode.

evidence.quote: ROCK GUYS: These are similar ot the cactus guys from the Old West...chapter. A couple hits and they will explode so watch out when they do.

subject: Purple Bats
text: Purple Bats are an improved version of the original bats.

evidence.quote: PURPLE BATS: Just a more improved version of the original.

subject: Big Green Blob
text: Big Green Blob is slow to move and breaks up into small green blobs after enough hits.

evidence.quote: BIG GREEN BLOB: Slow to move, once you hit it enough it will break up...into small green blobs.

subject: Small Green Blobs
text: Small Green Blobs are a little harder to kill than their predecessors.

evidence.quote: SMALL GREEN BLOBS: Just your average garden variety blob. A little...harder to kill than their predecessors.

subject: Knights
text: Knights walk around at a moderate speed and occasionally shoot spikes in groups of three.

evidence.quote: KNIGHTS: These knights in shining armor walk around at a moderate speed....They occasionally will shoot spikes in groups of three.

subject: Triceratops
text: Triceratops takes a deep breath and shoots a big ball that you can jump over but cannot shoot through.

evidence.quote: TRICERATOPS: These guys take a deep breath and then shoot a big ball at...you. You can jump over it but cannot shoot through it.

subject: Armored Knight
text: Armored Knights carry a shield preventing hits from the front and must be hit from behind to defeat them.

evidence.quote: ARMORED KNIGHT: These guys move and shoot the same way as regular...knights. The difference is that these guys carry a shield preventing you...from hitting them in the front. Hit them from behind to defeat them.
